name: LiveKit SIP
description: SIP to WebRTC bridge for LiveKit, connecting telephony networks with WebRTC-based communication rooms. Supports dialing in/out, DTMF, and digest authentication.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile and docker-compose.yaml present. Official image livekit/sip on Docker Hub. Requires host networking for UDP ports 5060 and 10000-20000.

eval_notes: Modern SIP-WebRTC bridge with Go implementation. Useful for testing telephony-to-WebRTC integration scenarios. Redis-backed session state enables distributed deployments.
